brief.Text: The corridor ahead is not quiet. Cull the Malah-Efewels, the Predator Rogues, then the Frozen and Glacial Spinetooths. Cascading Molokh holds a Bane of Ice. Use that bane on the Pulsating Ice Obelisk, destroy the Novictum Blight, and speak with Sheila Marlene. {completequest XK1F}

progress.Text: Keep to the ice corridor. When Sheila is free, come back to me here.

arrival.Text: Sheila is accounted for, even if she could not walk as a follower. Reprogrammed Mezzorash stands beside me. Strike it down, then return to Anticipating Six outside. {completequest XK1P}

mezz.Text: Reprogrammed Mezzorash is here. Finish it, then go back to Anticipating Six.

gosix.Text: Anticipating Six is outside, at the entrance.

after.Text: Anticipating Six already gave you what this place can give.
